title: Mixing: Listen To What The Man Said by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

Wings’ song ‘Listen To What The Man Said’ was mixed by studio engineer Alan O’Duffy on 15 March 1975.

O’Duffy was in the studio to review the recordings, which were complete with the exception of ‘Spirits Of Ancient Egypt’. He began mixing the Venus And Mars without Paul McCartney, the album’s producer, being present.

With the mix complete, O’Duffy ran off a cassette copy, and drove to the McCartneys’ rented Coldwater Canyon home to play it to them. Paul was impressed with the result, which was known as the ‘Alan O’Duffy Saturday Mix’, and it was used on both the single and album release.
